eve: Quick alert — QuillForge onboarding p95 spiked after yesterday's model pin. p95 ~2.5s (baseline ~1.0s). Traffic: mostly short chats with occasional long contexts. Proactive idea: run a 5% canary to a compact int4 variant, enable prefix cache for short-chat route, and lower max_batch_wait_ms. Need SE + SRE ok.

sam: Link & token distro?

eve: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quillforge/onboard-latency. Token distro: 80% <80, 18% 80-512, 2% >512. Spike aligns with a new partner integration increasing concurrency. No errors.

noah: Plan sounds good. Steps: 1) 5% canary -> redwood-compact-13b-int4, 2) prefix/KV cache on short route TTL=30s, 3) set batching.max_batch_wait_ms=6, 4) rollback on 3 consecutive p95 breaches.

sam: Risks: semantic delta (low) — mitigate with 10-prompt eval set; stale cache if dynamic system prompts (med) — mitigate with short TTL + mismatch alerts; throughput impact (med) — mitigate with autoscale burst.

eve: I'll run the canary and notify QuillForge. SEs, please draft route override and eval set.

noah: Draft snippet: route=/v1/chat/completions, canary=5%, model=redwood-compact-13b-int4, overrides: batching.max_batch_wait_ms=6, cache.prefix=true, cache.ttl_ms=30000. Also enable tracing for top endpoints.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: start=6198767400 (11:30 UTC), duration=20m, route=/v1/chat/completions, percent=5, owner=eve. Command: `/canary start --route /v1/chat/completions --model redwood-compact-13b-int4 --percent 5 --duration 20m`

eve: Notifying customer: "We will run a 20m canary at 11:30 UTC to test a compact model + caching tweak; no downtime expected; will share p50/p95, KV hit rates, and eval deltas within 30m after the run." :thumbsup:

sam: I'll monitor p50/p95, queue lengths, KV hit-rate and eval metrics. Abort if eval similarity drops >2% or p95 regresses.

noah: Good. Tracing and autoscale guards enabled. Report back here after the window.
